method: Exact OPL2 pre-clip stem RMS over one complete loop; direct per-stem RMS matching against uncalibrated 2A03, VRC6/VRC7/Sunsoft 5B/MMC5, GB/GBC APU, GBA PSG/Direct Sound, and SNES S-DSP stems. The 5B pass uses the complete tone/noise/envelope/mixer core and three independent AC-coupled outputs. MMC5 uses two sweep-less pulse channels and a streamed 8-bit PCM voice with hardware polarity. NES-family percussion target power is split 10% Noise / 90% DMC; Game Boy percussion is split by source events: kick power targets a time-shared 4-bit Wave RAM transient, while snare/hi-hat power targets hardware Noise. SNES uses eight stable 32 kHz BRR/S-DSP voices; each selected source maps one-to-one to one calibrated voice before FIR echo.
